name: Dynamic Map Platform Co.,Ltd.
summary: Dynamic Map Platform Co., Ltd. builds highly accurate 3D data platforms that recreate the physical world in digital form, working in Japan and North America. It produces and distributes precise 3D map data used in self-driving and driver-assistance technology, including 3Dmapspocket, a platform for viewing and analyzing 3D point cloud data. Formerly Dynamic Map Planning Co., Ltd., it took its present name in 2017 and has its head office in Tokyo, Japan.
